articles.title: Saudi Arabia exits China-backed mBridge CBDC project: FT
articles.description: Saudi Arabia has left mBridge, a cross-border CBDC platform that has drawn scrutiny from US policymakers, according to the Financial Times.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Ondo lets institutions convert stocks directly into tokenized shares
articles.description: Ondo’s new in-kind conversion system allows approved institutions to mint and redeem tokenized stocks and ETFs using the underlying securities instead of cash.

articles.title: Crypto PAC to spend $30M opposing Sherrod Brown in Ohio, again
articles.description: The digital asset-aligned PAC joined other groups to spend more than a combined $300 million in the 2024 Ohio Senate race, resulting in Sherrod Brown’s loss to Bernie Moreno.

articles.title: Circle launches Bitcoin-backed USDC borrowing for institutional clients
articles.description: Circle is bringing Bitcoin-backed borrowing to institutional clients, allowing them to tap BTC holdings for USDC liquidity without selling their Bitcoin.

articles.title: Bitcoin price tags $86K as analysis sees crypto in ‘new bull market’
articles.description: Bitcoin crossed the $86,000 mark for the first time since late January as falling oil prices and concerns over supply lifted US stocks.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: CLARITY Act setback puts Coinbase in the spotlight
articles.description: Coinbase draws scrutiny after the CLARITY Act stalls, while the SEC moves ahead with tokenized stocks and crypto firms push deeper into payments.

articles.title: Kyle Samani predicts SOL flippening, claims ‘no one’ uses ETH
articles.description: Multicoin Capital co-founder Samani expects SOL to surpass Ether’s market capitalization “this market cycle” and argues that “today, no one really uses Ethereum.”

articles.title: Strategy buys 950 Bitcoin for $76M, repurchases $174M in STRC
articles.description: Strategy bought 950 Bitcoin for $75.7 million after a two-week pause and spent another $174 million repurchasing its STRC preferred stock.

articles.title: ECB launches Pontes to settle tokenized assets without stablecoins
articles.description: Pontes will expand its services and operating hours gradually, with full implementation expected by 2028 and more participants set to join.

articles.title: NEAR jumps nearly 80% in a week as Intents volume nears $30B
articles.description: Near expanded privacy features for traders as NEAR Intents recorded $29.3 billion in cumulative volume, including swaps involving Zcash.

articles.title: BTC price nears eight-month high above $85K: Five things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: Bitcoin hit $85,000 for the first time since January as markets focused on cooling oil prices.

articles.title: X sues Bitcoin account operators over alleged $278K payout fraud
articles.description: X alleges six Bitcoin-focused accounts coordinated posts and engagement to inflate creator payouts, with claimed and projected losses of at least $378,000.

articles.title: ZetaChain holders approve plan to wind down L1, move ZETA to Solana
articles.description: ZetaChain plans to wind down its Cosmos-based layer 1 and migrate ZETA to Solana, joining other crypto projects moving away from standalone chains.

articles.title: Bank of Korea launches 24-hour won settlement pilot for foreign investors
articles.description: The Bank of Korea’s new network will let foreign investors settle won transactions during business hours in their home countries.

articles.title: Bitcoin reclaims 50-week moving average as analysts eye end of bear market
articles.description: Bitcoin’s move above its 50-week moving average has historically marked the end of bear markets, but analysts say one weekly close isn’t enough to confirm a new bull run.

articles.title: Hana Bank taps Euroclear blockchain for $100M bond issuance: Report
articles.description: The five-year digital bond reportedly shortened settlement from three to five business days to the same day using Euroclear’s blockchain infrastructure.

articles.title: North Korean fake recruiters infect 30K devices, steal $10.7M in crypto
articles.description: North Korean cyber group WaterPlum targeted developers with fake jobs at crypto, AI and NFT companies, infecting at least 30,000 devices across more than 100 countries.

articles.title: Who needs CLARITY anyway? ARB could see 70X increase: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: Crypto missed out on CLARITY, but tokenized stocks were legalized and the Bitcoin Reserve advanced. Meanwhile Standard Chartered says Arbitrum’s price could increase 70 times by 2030.

articles.title: Trump says US will form ‘AI Force’ and appoint AI czar: Reports
articles.description: Trump posted on Truth Social that his new project would manage the fast-growing sector without adding regulations that could slow innovation.

articles.title: Grayscale’s Zcash ETF files for 3-for-1 forward share split
articles.description: At the close of trading on Sept. 28, shareholders will receive two extra shares for each one they hold.

articles.title: Anthropic taps Accenture as embedded evaluator to help with AI slowdown proposal
articles.description: The partnership is non-exclusive, and Anthropic expects to announce other evaluators in forthcoming weeks with which it will also work.

articles.title: REX launches 2x leveraged ETF tied to Bitcoin treasury firm Strive
articles.description: The new ASSX fund offers 2x daily exposure to Strive shares, giving traders a leveraged way to bet on the Bitcoin treasury company.

articles.title: Kalshi joins Coinbase with own filing for US stock perpetual futures
articles.description: Kalshi’s proposal would bring perpetual futures tied to individual stocks to US traders, as Coinbase and Bitnomial pursue similar products.

articles.title: VanEck criticizes Metaplanet over executive dilution despite compensation cuts
articles.description: VanEck said Metaplanet’s executive equity exposure remains well above its digital asset treasury peers, even after the company cut its potential share pool by 41%.

articles.title: Bastion wins conditional OCC approval for national trust bank charter
articles.description: Bastion Platforms National Trust Company will offer stablecoin custody and wallets, payment infrastructure and white-label issuance from a single federally regulated entity.

articles.title: Hong Kong jails ex-banker over $1.6B false credit, cryptocurrency bribes: Report
articles.description: Former banking official gets four years in prison over false letters of credit and accepting $470,000 in cryptocurrency bribes.

articles.title: Coinbase files to bring single-stock perpetual futures to US market
articles.description: Coinbase wants to bring 24/5 perpetual futures trading to individual US stocks, with its proposed contracts now awaiting regulatory approval.

articles.title: Binance launches 24/7 FX perps with weekend pricing system
articles.description: Binance is joining a growing number of crypto exchanges offering around-the-clock exposure to foreign exchange markets through perpetual futures.

articles.title: Crypto stocks rebound after CLARITY Act selloff
articles.description: Coinbase, Strategy and other crypto-linked stocks rallied Friday as the CFTC and SEC moved ahead with crypto-related actions under existing authority.
